Subject: DRR evidence — initial assessment and noticed gaps

Markus,

Thanks for the packet you sent Friday. We reviewed the DRR evidence and have a few items we need clarified before the audit team can sign off:

Can you respond with the specific files and a short note on the timeline? Security will need the items before 2027-05-28.

Best,

Vendome Capital

- Keystore rotation: step-by-step (stop-restore, mount-keystore, rotate-key, verify-signatures) with command examples and expected diff hashes.
- Post-restore validation: checksums + smoke-test endpoints list and expected success counts.

The operations team witnessed and recorded the sequence; supporting logs and timestamp samples have been provided. Redwood can make staff available to witness a live replay on 2027-06-08 (10:00-12:00 PT) or 2027-06-09 (14:00-16:00 PT)."

If Vendome wants the full replay log, please confirm preferred transfer method and whether we should mask additional fields.

Attachments: runbook-restore-snippets.txt, dr_evidence_manifest_v2.pdf

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Site Reliability
